mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a negative 20-day forward return in more than 40% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE < 4% and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM < -2% and negative 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the correlation between this joint condition and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and UNRATE MoM < 0%) does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between this joint condition and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) is growing, it signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 QoQ > 0%) does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between this joint condition and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
